newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon to enlarge air base in $50 mln project.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon to enlarge air base in $50 mln project.

text.p: Lebanon will turn a military air base in the north into a commercial airport that can handle up to one million passengers a year in a $50 million project, a cabinet minister said.

Information Minister Bassem al-Sabaa told reporters after an evening cabinet session on Wednesday that work on the 20-month project in the air base of Qlaiaat, north of Beirut, would begin after the government sets conditions for companies to bid.

"The project includes the rehabilitation of the main runway...The rehabilitation of existing buildings, the construction of a 75,000 square metre new building for passengers, and the reconstruction of infrastructure," Sabaa said.

The cabinet ordered the Investment Development Authority of Lebanon -- an independent government-agency for investment planning -- to propose a plan for awarding the project on a Build, Operate and Transfer (B.O.T.) basis, Sabaa said.
He added that the project was the first phase of an ambitious plan to further enlarge the capacity of Qlaiaat airport to handle up to three million passengers every year.
"The project will also add to the efficiency of a free-trade zone to be established in the airport...over an area of 300,000 to 500,000 square metres," Sabaa added.
